programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Chori Mera Kaam
programme.desc: Two petty thieves, Raja and Balu, take refuge in Anjali's house while escaping from the police. When Raja learns about Anjali's misery, he decides to help her.

programme.title: Man On Mission Fauladi
programme.desc: Sobhanadri, a criminal leader, adopts an orphan Sivaji and raises him like his godson. Issues erupt when in order to teach his own son a lesson, he decides to grant his riches to Sivaji.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Madrangi
programme.desc: Deepu, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with her driver Manu. Problems arise when Manu suffers a brain injury and is blamed for the death of an MLA's brother.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Mufasa: The Lion King
programme.desc: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline - a chance meeting which sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny. Prequel to Disney's live-action 2019 movie, with the voices of Aaron Pierre, Kelvin Harrison Jnr and Tiffany Boone.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: The Amateur
programme.desc: When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a cryptographer takes matters into his own hands. Thriller, starring Rami Malek, Laurence Fishburne, Rachel Brosnahan and Jon Bernthal.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Flubber
programme.desc: A scatty professor is in financial trouble, and his only hope of avoiding disaster is to market his latest invention - a strange rubbery substance with a life of its own. However, a criminal gang is determined to get hold of his creation. Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.desc: Chief Benja and his 'dragon nerd' daughter Raya proudly protect a luminescent stone that protects humanity from a plague borne of discord called the Druun. One poor judgement allows the darkness to return, and Raya embarks on a perilous quest to restore peace by completing a series of Indiana-Jones-style obstacles. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Marie Tran, Awkwafina, Izaac Wang and Gemma Chan.

programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.desc: Indianapolis teenager Hazel has terminal thyroid cancer and attends a patients' support group, where she meets fellow teen Gus, who lost a leg to the disease. The two fall in love and a shared passion for books leads them on a literary pilgrimage to Amsterdam in search of reclusive author Peter van Houten. Romantic drama based on the bestselling novel by John Green, starring Shailene Woodley, Ansel Elgort, Laura Dern and Willem Dafoe.

He must use his new skills to carry out a special mission - helping the inventor to steal back his miniaturisation technology from a ruthless businessman who intends to turn it into a deadly weapon. Superhero adventure, starring Paul Rudd, Michael Douglas and Evangeline Lilly.

programme.desc: Glasgow. Dave and Si continue their adventure in Glasgow, on the hunt for new ingredients to include on the menu of a Scottish-Malaysian fusion restaurant. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Jamie's One Pan Wonders
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver cooks a super-speedy smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger with sweet red peppers, pickles and mustard, and toffee apple buns. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Jamie's One Pan Wonders
programme.desc: Jamie cooks an aubergine burger, a sesame-seared salmon supper, and a chickpea and squash casserole that can be turned into a host of tasty dishes. S1, Ep8

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ranchin' And Cookin'. Ree Drummond tackles a busy morning of ranching and get-ahead cooking. She creates the ultimate meatball and polenta casserole and hasselback chicken. S23, Ep8

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Sweet Talk. Ree Drummond celebrates the opening of her new sweet shop. She makes an incredible jewelled divinity and two over-the-top ice cream sundaes. S23, Ep9

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Northumberland. James samples the delights of Northumberland, joined by Michelin-starred chef Kenny Atkinson. They learn how mead is made on Holy Island. S1, Ep13

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: For Italian week, the bakers create a Sicilian signature and a deceptively tricky technical. The heat is on with a showstopper in the hottest temperatures recorded in the tent. S8, Ep7

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The remaining five bakers go back in time with unfamiliar recipes for forgotten bakes week. There's a sweet and savoury signature challenge and Prue sets a boozy technical. S8, Ep8

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James heads to the Languedoc, known as the heart of authentic France. He's treated to mouth-watering cassoulet and discovers delicious local ingredients. S1, Ep3

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James enjoys the picturesque views and delicious food in Charente. He uses Cognac for his first al fresco cook and makes a classic French onion soup. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Meat And Sweet. Guy Fieri seeks meat with a little sweet. In Santa Barbara, he visits a hidden gem serving Korean paella, then he visits a Boca Raton food truck. S37, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Mediterranean & Mofongo. In Florida, Guy Fieri finds a funky spot that puts a Mediterranean spin on burgers. Then, he visits a local gem dishing out Puerto Rican specialties. S37, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: A World Of Meat. Guy Fieri seeks out meaty mashups! First up in Boise, Idaho, a Russian joint serves light-out lamb, and then a Pakistani spot cooks up flavourful goat. S37, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Pick-Me-Ups. In Boise, Idaho, Guy Fieri samples flavourful sandwiches and empanadas. Then, a funky joint in Savannah serves up real-deal wood-fired pizza and bagels. S37, Ep5

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Daddy's Girl. When the owners of Geppino's Sicilian Kitchen in California hear customer complaints about stolen items, the mystery diners go undercover to identify the thief. S7, Ep13

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Thanksgiving Thievery. The owner of Tavern on Main fears someone on his staff is stealing donations from his restaurant's annual Thanksgiving Food Drive. S8, Ep1

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Flamenco And Capture The Flag. Buddy flaunts his dance moves when he designs a flamenco cake. Meanwhile, Mauro and the team make a cake for a nearby summer camp, and it gets messy! S9, Ep3

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Color Run And Back To School. The team creates a cake to mark an event for the Mayor of Newark providing school supplies for kids. Madeline makes a rainbow cake for a charity run! S9, Ep4

programme.title: Cold Case Forensics: In the Blood
programme.desc: S2 E3World-leading forensic scientist Angela Gallop and her team reveal how clues in blood traces helped solve two terrible crimes, including the high-profile killing of 10-year-old Damilola Taylor, which shocked the nation when he was stabbed to death in November 2000.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: S2 E4Fern joins the veterinary team at the Grove and meets Rory, a golden retriever with a lump on his eyelid, and Pedro the cockapoo who is in to remove a concerning growth on his chin. Vet Amy investigates the curious case of Odin the cat's appetite loss, and fluffy feline Tokyo needs treatment for a fractured tooth.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — DallasThe travelling chef visits Dallas, heading to Southfork, the location made famous in the TV series Dallas. James gets a tour before cooking in the grounds of the ranch. Once in the heart of the city, James goes to the Texas State Fair and gets and peak at the preparations happening for the huge annual event. While there he tries two Texan classics - the corny dog followed by deep fried butter. After a deep-fried, fast food hit, James then visits the arts district with a culinary stop at one of the major players in the city's fine dining scene, The Flora Street Cafe.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: S9 E20James is back in the kitchen on a Saturday morning where he's joined by presenter Josie Gibson, Olympic cyclist Victoria Pendleton, barman Merlin Griffiths and chefs Dipna Anand and Tom Shepherd.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: E62 — 16/08/2026A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S4 E24Alan is joined at Manor Farm by actress Eileen Atkins and Coronation Street star William Roache. Plus, the best in drought-resistant plants, and two rare-breed Guernsey goats.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: S2 E6Andy performs surgery on a dog to remove a worrying tumour from its stomach, while Amy uses ultrasound to investigate a cat's missing kidney, and James removes an infected wart from a geriatric Springerdoodle. A two-year-old cat is back for X-rays on its leg following surgery last year, and Fern meets pets and volunteers taking part in a foster-care scheme run by Bristol Animal Rescue Centre.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Chestnuts & PastaTom explores Italy's mountains, uncovering the culinary secrets of chestnuts and pasta. In Emilia-Romagna's Apennines, he joins producer Adrian for the chestnut harvest, then prepares pork loin with chestnuts and wild mushrooms. Later, amid the spectacular Dolomites, he discovers how the fresh mountain environment shapes the region's distinctive cuisine today.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: E62 — 16/08/2026 - 1Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Force of Nature
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Savage SeasThe world's coastal regions have always been an extreme environment to raise a family, but warming seas are exacerbating the challenges of parenthood. A hurricane hits a flamingo colony while chicks are still on the nest, a sea otter faces a huge winter storm in California, a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef sees its anemone home bleached, and a little anole lizard clings on during a hurricane.

programme.title: Octopussy
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Roger Moore, Maud Adams and Louis Jourdan. A British agent killed in East Germany is found dressed as a clown, clutching a priceless Fabergé egg. programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. programme.desc: Xu Quanyi sees it as his mission to promote the charm of Fukushima. Sharing his stories is how he counters the stigma Fukushima continues to suffer following the 2011 disaster.

programme.title: Polar Bear Crisis
programme.desc: The latest research highlights the polar region crisis, with the lowest ever levels of sea ice and a polar bear population 50% reduced in 42 years in some areas. We look at wildlife in the Arctic.

programme.desc: Aichi / Kataoka Mami (curator) Tokoname, a pottery town with over 900 years of history, creates products appropriate for the times. Kataoka finds the beauty that's present in functional objects.

programme.title: BOSAI: Soil Liquefaction
programme.desc: When a major earthquake hits, the ground can turn into muddy water. This is called liquefaction. Buildings may sink or tilt and become uninhabitable. Find out the mechanisms and how to prevent it.
